**Observation Log**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 17:30
- [USER] Part 34 discusses the conclusion that the date of the Final Occupation Certificate (FOC) is not the date on which the building works were completed.
- [USER] States that the definition of building works does not include the rectification of defects notified during the defects liability period.
- [USER] References cl 1 of the contract, defining building works as those that are “carried out, completed and handed over to the owner.”
- [USER] Cites cl 1 defining practical completion as when building works are complete except for minor omissions and defects.
- [USER] Mentions cl 29.1, stating that the defects liability period commences “on and including the date of practical completion.”
- [USER] Refers to cl 29.2, which allows the owner to give the builder “one list of defects in the building works that appear after the date of practical completion.”
- [USER] States that sections 48K(7) and 3B of the HB Act are relevant to the date of completion of the works.
- [USER] Quotes s 48K(7) of the HB Act regarding the Tribunal's jurisdiction in building claims.
- [USER] Notes that s 3B was introduced by the Home Building Amendment Act 2011 and applies to residential building work commenced or completed before 1 February 2012.
- [USER] Explains that s 3B(1) states that completion of residential building work occurs on the date that the work is complete within the meaning of the contract.
- [USER] Clarifies that if the contract does not provide for when work is complete, s 3B(2) applies, defining practical completion.
- [USER] States that the contract does not require the provision of an FOC as a condition of practical completion.
- [USER] Mentions s 3B(3) provides a rebuttable presumption that residential building work is complete when an occupation certificate is issued.
- [USER] Concludes that the Tribunal erred in finding the completion date for the works was 20 October 2010.
- [USER] States that the completion date for the works was the date of practical completion under the contract, which was before 20 October 2010.
- [USER] Indicates that the owners took possession of the works on 13 July 2017.
- [USER] Asserts that the issue of the FOC is not the completion date of the works under s 3B.
- [USER] Concludes that if the completion date was not the date of practical completion (8 July 2010), it was the date the works were handed over to the owners (13 July 2021).
- [USER] States that the Tribunal's finding regarding the completion date
